basic_details.job_title: NeGD Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for AI Engineer, Senior Data Scientist Posts

age_limit.details: All Posts: Maximum age is 55 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related field with 5-9 years of experience
qualification.details: AI Engineer: Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field from a recognised university. Minimum 5-9 years of professional experience in full-stack application development, of which at least three (3) years on AI or large language model-enabled applications taken to production. Senior Data Scientist: Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics or a related quantitative field from a recognised university. Minimum 6-10 years of experience in applied data science and machine learning, of which at least four (4) years on models deployed to production.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NeGD Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NeGD to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: AI Engineer: Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field from a recognised university. Minimum 5-9 years of professional experience in full-stack application development, of which at least three (3) years on AI or large language model-enabled applications taken to production. Senior Data Scientist: Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics or a related quantitative field from a recognised university. Minimum 6-10 years of experience in applied data science and machine learning, of which at least four (4) years on models deployed to production.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NeGD Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NeGD to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National e-Governance Division (NeGD) for various technical and engineering positions under their governance projects for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions under this recruitment drive are AI Engineer and Senior Data Scientist, aimed at bolstering advanced technological capabilities within the division.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced across different posts, with 2 openings for AI Engineer and 1 opening for Senior Data Scientist.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 15 October 2026. Candidates must ensure applications are submitted prior to this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for AI Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field with relevant production experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Senior Data Scientist?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics or a related quantitative field with experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts advertised under this notification is 55 years, making it suitable for experienced industry professionals.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these roles?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for both AI Engineer and Senior Data Scientist roles are eligible to receive a salary package of maximum up to 38,50,008/- per year.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for the recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online through the official application portal designated by the Digital India Corporation and NeGD website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for NeGD posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an initial screening of applications based on qualifications, age, and relevant experience, followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates.
